description: Точечные project-local guards для canonical AzurPilot workflow.

hooks.command: root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0; [ -n "$root" ] || exit 0; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$root/.codex/hooks/codex_workflow_guards.py"; else echo "AzurPilot hook: python3 недоступен" >&2; exit 2; fi
hooks.commandWindows: where py >nul 2>&1 & if errorlevel 1 (echo AzurPilot hook: py -3 недоступен 1>&2 & exit /b 2) else py -3 -c "import pathlib,runpy; p=pathlib.Path.cwd(); root=next((x for x in (p,*p.parents) if (x/'.codex'/'hooks.json').is_file()), None); runpy.run_path(str(root/'.codex'/'hooks'/'codex_workflow_guards.py'), run_name='__main__') if root is not None else None"
